When an XDP redirect happens before the link is ready
transmission will not finish and will timeout
reset. If the redirects do not stop
resetting.
Wait for the driver to signal that there's a carrier before allowing
transmissions to proceed.
Previous code was relying that when __IGC_DOWN is cleared
ready to transmit as all the queues are ready
the carrier presence will only be signaled later
workqueue has a chance to run. And during this interval (between
clearing __IGC_DOWN and the watchdog running) if any transmission
happens the timeout is emitted (detected by igc_tx_timeout()) which
causes the reset
column2: with the potential for the infinite loop.
